title: wei.series.md.c1.c2.c3: Estimating Reliability of Weibull Components in Series from Masked Data
description: R package for maximum likelihood estimation of Weibull component parameters in series systems from masked failure data. Implements the methodology from Towell (2023) for right-censored system lifetimes and masked component failure causes via candidate sets satisfying identifiability conditions C1, C2, and C3.
